items.title: Extension of scalars preserves flatness: \mathcal{G} flat over \mathcal{O}_1 \Rightarrow \mathcal{G} \otimes_{\mathcal{O}_1} \mathcal{O}_2 flat over \mathcal{O}_2
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-modules.tex (Modules on Sites)

items.difficulty_reason: The proof displays the change-of-rings identity (\mathcal{G} \otimes_{\mathcal{O}_1} \mathcal{O}_2) \otimes_{\mathcal{O}_2} \mathcal{H} = \mathcal{G} \otimes_{\mathcal{O}_1} \mathcal{H} (as sheaves of abelian groups, for example), by which tensoring over \mathcal{O}_2 with \mathcal{H} against the extension of scalars is the same functor as tensoring over \mathcal{O}_1 with \mathcal{H} — exact in \mathcal{H} because \mathcal{G} is \mathcal{O}_1-flat. The displayed identity is the complete derivation; the author's verbatim text writes \mathcal{F} for the right-hand module (an arbitary test module), delivered as-is.
